notes: ACCESS: Shopify store, robots.txt allows tier (a)/(b) fully and does not disallow any Claude agent UA (agentic UCP/MCP note present, no Claude-specific block). Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) fetched robots.txt, homepage HTML and the collections sitemap (1144 URLs) fine, but the raw homepage HTML only exposed ~11 top-nav /collections/ links - the mega-menu itself is client-rendered, so escalated to tier (b). Playwright headless (chromium, wait_until=load/domcontentloaded + settle delay) rendered the full header mega-menu (86+ distinct /collections/ links across Rugs, Bedding, Furniture, Pillows & Throws, Decor, Bath, Archive Sale, and country/promo banners) - used for the real category tree; no tier (c) needed. TREE: built from the union of rendered mega-menu (primary) and the sitemap_collections XML (cross-check only - the sitemap's 1144 collections are almost entirely auto-generated tag/vendor/sale/origin collections such as 'the-sunset-sale-baskets', 'uganda-baskets', 'presidents-day-event-baskets' that are not part of standing site navigation and were excluded as promotional/collection pages, not genuine categories). QTY: products.json (?limit=250) proved unreliable on this store (e.g. returned 0 for 'Organic Cotton Bedding' while the live rendered page shows 'Products' via a custom search/discovery layer), so every retained row's qty was taken from the rendered collection page's own visible 'N Products' header text after Playwright render, cross-checked against the page <title>/canonical to confirm the right node was loaded. EXCLUDED: Furniture top-nav entirely (Bedroom/Living Room/Bath/Outdoor/Custom Seating/Beds/Ottomans/Chairs/Tables/Dressers/Accent Furniture - all explicitly under the site's own Furniture menu, including Dressers per storage.md SS21/27 furniture-boundary rule since the site places them under Furniture, not Storage); 'Rug Pads & Accessories' (verified via products.json - sole product is 'Eco-Friendly Rug Pad', a non-textile grip-pad accessory, treated like curtain hardware); 'Baskets & Accents' (all-baskets, 24 products checked via products.json - mixed decor collection: Totora Storage Basket, Hinoki Wood Floor Mirror, Tikal Wood Bud Vase, Azad Leather Tray, Terranova Vase etc - only 1 of 24 is a genuine storage basket, so the category as a whole is decor-primary per storage.md SS5/23, not a valid Storage category; no dedicated storage-only basket subcategory exists on-site so Storage = []); 'Framed Art' (wall decor, not textile); 'Kitchen Essentials' (mixed serving boards/glassware/vases/candles/stools with one incidental tablecloth - not primarily textile, out of scope); 'Bath Accessories' (marble tissue box/soap dispenser/canister/wastebasket - decorative bath accessories, not textile or storage); 'Bath Furniture' (furniture); 'Ready to Ship Rugs' (shop-in-stock-rugs / in-stock-collection-rugs, two divergent-count duplicates of the same title) and all 'Trending/New Arrivals/Best Sellers/Back in Stock/Archive Sale/Ready to Ship' cross-cutting availability collections, plus rug 'Shop by Size' (2x3/6x9/8x10/9x12/10x14) and pillow 'Shop by Size/Color/Pattern' and blanket 'Shop by Material' - all filter/availability shortcuts over the same underlying products already counted under their type-based category, not distinct standing categories; 'Rugs by Style' (browse-by-style hub, same pattern); 'Shop All' parent links per the parent-URL rule since valid subcategories exist under each; country/region promo collections (Portugal/Morocco/India/Japan/Peru/Mexico) and all guide/blog pages (bedding-guide, towel-guide, rug-pads blog, etc). 'Wall Hangings' verified as genuine Textile (not Wall Decor) by reading a sample product page (Emir Kilim Wall Hanging): 'Crafted with an intricate slit-weave technique... Handwoven', confirming woven/textile construction per textile.md SS14. Bedding 'Stonewashed Linen Bedding'/'Organic Cotton Bedding'/'Luxe Sateen Bedding' are permanent material-focused nav entries under the Bedding mega-menu column (not one-off seasonal marketing) so were kept as valid Textile subcategories but marked MEDIUM confidence since their products likely overlap with the type-based Sheets/Duvets/Bundles/Blankets rows above (same catalog, different material-based cut - counted as separate listing pages per the site's own hierarchy, not aggregated).
